epithet.en: Trojan prince, founder of Rome's lineage
epithet.da: Trojansk prins, stamfader til Roms slægt

1.modern-en: Driven by a storm onto the coast of Africa, Aeneas rallies his exhausted men and is welcomed by Dido, Queen of Carthage.
1.modern-da: Drevet af en storm ind mod Afrikas kyst samler Aeneas sine udmattede mænd og bydes velkommen af Dido, Karthagos dronning.

2.modern-en: Tells Dido the story of Troy's fall — the wooden horse, the slaughter, his escape carrying his father Anchises on his back, and the loss of his wife Creusa.
2.modern-da: Fortæller Dido om Trojas fald — træhesten, blodsudgydelsen, hans flugt med faderen Anchises på ryggen og tabet af sin hustru Creusa.

3.modern-en: Continues his tale: the fleet he built, his wanderings through Thrace, Delos, Crete, and the Strophades. Arrives in Sicily, where his father Anchises dies.
3.modern-da: Fortsætter sin fortælling: flåden han byggede, hans vandringer gennem Thrakien, Delos, Kreta og Strofaderne. Ankommer til Sicilien, hvor hans far Anchises dør.

4.modern-en: Falls in love with Dido. Jupiter sends Mercury to remind him of his destiny. He resolves to leave. Dido, in anguish, kills herself as his fleet sails away.
4.modern-da: Forelsker sig i Dido. Jupiter sender Merkur for at minde ham om hans skæbne. Han beslutter at rejse. Dido dræber sig selv i fortvivlelse, mens hans flåde sejler bort.

5.modern-en: Returns to Sicily and holds funeral games for Anchises. The Trojan women set fire to the ships, but most are saved. Leaves the weary behind and sails for Italy.
5.modern-da: Vender tilbage til Sicilien og afholder begravelseslege for Anchises. De trojanske kvinder sætter ild til skibene, men de fleste reddes. Efterlader de trætte og sejler mod Italien.

6.modern-en: Reaches Cumae and descends into the underworld guided by the Sibyl. Meets his father Anchises, who shows him the future souls of Rome's greatest heroes.
6.modern-da: Når Cumae og stiger ned i underverdenen med Sibyllen som guide. Møder sin far Anchises, der viser ham de fremtidige sjæle af Roms største helte.

7.modern-en: Arrives in Latium. King Latinus offers him his daughter Lavinia. Juno incites Turnus and the Latin queen to war against the Trojans.
7.modern-da: Ankommer til Latium. Kong Latinus tilbyder ham sin datter Lavinia. Juno opildner Turnus og den latinske dronning til krig mod trojanerne.

8.modern-en: Travels upriver to seek alliance with Evander. Receives divine armor forged by Vulcan, its shield depicting the future glory of Rome.
8.modern-da: Rejser op ad floden for at søge alliance med Evander. Modtager guddommelig rustning smedet af Vulkan, med et skjold der afbilder Roms fremtidige storhed.

9.modern-en: While Aeneas is away, Turnus attacks the Trojan camp. The ships are miraculously transformed into sea nymphs.
9.modern-da: Mens Aeneas er borte, angriber Turnus den trojanske lejr. Skibene forvandles mirakuløst til havnymfer.

10.modern-en: Returns with Tuscan allies and joins the battle. Kills Lausus and then Mezentius, the brutal Etruscan tyrant.
10.modern-da: Vender tilbage med tuskanske allierede og kaster sig ind i kampen. Dræber Lausus og derefter Mezentius, den brutale etruskiske tyran.

11.modern-en: Grants a truce for burying the dead. Sends Pallas's body home with great ceremony.
11.modern-da: Bevilger våbenhvile til begravelse af de faldne. Sender Pallas' lig hjem med store æresbevisninger.

12.modern-en: Faces Turnus in single combat. Wounded and healed by Venus, he pursues Turnus across the battlefield. Kills him after seeing Pallas's belt on his body.
12.modern-da: Møder Turnus i tvekamp. Såret og helbredt af Venus forfølger han Turnus over slagmarken. Dræber ham efter at have set Pallas' bælte på hans krop.

1.modern-en: Welcomes the shipwrecked Trojans to Carthage with feasts and generosity. Venus makes her fall in love with Aeneas.
1.modern-da: Byder de skibbrudne trojanere velkommen i Karthago med fester og gavmildhed. Venus får hende til at forelske sig i Aeneas.

4.modern-en: Consumed by her love for Aeneas. When he resolves to leave at Jupiter's command, she pleads, rages, and finally kills herself on a funeral pyre as his ships sail away.
4.modern-da: Fortæret af sin kærlighed til Aeneas. Da han beslutter at rejse på Jupiters befaling, bønfalder hun, raser og dræber til sidst sig selv på et begravelsesbål, mens hans skibe sejler bort.

6.modern-en: Aeneas encounters her shade in the underworld. She turns away without speaking, still unforgiving.
6.modern-da: Aeneas møder hendes skygge i underverdenen. Hun vender sig bort uden at tale, stadig utilgivende.

epithet.en: Prince of the Rutulians, Aeneas's rival

7.modern-en: Incited by Juno's fury Allecto, he raises an army against the Trojans and breaks King Latinus's peace.
7.modern-da: Opildnet af Junos furie Allecto rejser han en hær mod trojanerne og bryder kong Latinus' fred.

9.modern-en: Attacks the Trojan camp while Aeneas is away. Tries to burn the fleet. Fights fiercely but is pushed back.
9.modern-da: Angriber den trojanske lejr, mens Aeneas er borte. Forsøger at brænde flåden. Kæmper vildt, men drives tilbage.

10.modern-en: Kills young Pallas in combat and strips his belt — a decision that will seal his own fate.
10.modern-da: Dræber den unge Pallas i kamp og tager hans bælte — en beslutning der vil besegle hans egen skæbne.

11.modern-en: Faces pressure from the Latin war council to make peace. Refuses. Warrior maiden Camilla dies fighting for his cause.
11.modern-da: Møder pres fra det latinske krigsråd om at slutte fred. Afslår. Krigerinden Camilla dør i kamp for hans sag.

12.modern-en: Challenges Aeneas to single combat. Fights bravely but is defeated. Begs for mercy, but Aeneas sees Pallas's belt and kills him in fury.
12.modern-da: Udfordrer Aeneas til tvekamp. Kæmper tappert, men besejres. Beder om nåde, men Aeneas ser Pallas' bælte og dræber ham i vrede.

2.modern-en: Old and frail, carried out of burning Troy on Aeneas's back. A divine sign convinces him to flee.
2.modern-da: Gammel og svag, båret ud af det brændende Troja på Aeneas' ryg. Et guddommeligt tegn overbeviser ham om at flygte.

3.modern-en: Travels with the fleet through years of wandering. Dies peacefully in Sicily before they reach Italy.
3.modern-da: Rejser med flåden gennem år af omvandring. Dør fredeligt på Sicilien, inden de når Italien.

5.modern-en: Dead but honored through funeral games held on the anniversary of his death in Sicily.
5.modern-da: Død, men æret gennem begravelseslege afholdt på årsdagen for hans død på Sicilien.

6.modern-en: Meets Aeneas in the underworld's Elysian Fields. Shows him the parade of future Roman souls — the destiny his suffering serves.
6.modern-da: Møder Aeneas i underverdenens Elysiske Marker. Viser ham paraden af fremtidige romerske sjæle — den skæbne hans lidelser tjener.

1.modern-en: Pleads with Jupiter for her son's safety. Appears to Aeneas disguised as a huntress and guides him to Carthage. Makes Dido fall in love with him.
1.modern-da: Bønfalder Jupiter om sin søns sikkerhed. Viser sig for Aeneas forklædt som jægerinde og fører ham til Karthago. Får Dido til at forelske sig i ham.

2.modern-en: Appears during Troy's fall to reveal the gods destroying the city. Tells Aeneas to flee and protects his family.
2.modern-da: Viser sig under Trojas fald for at afsløre guderne, der ødelægger byen. Beder Aeneas flygte og beskytter hans familie.

8.modern-en: Persuades Vulcan to forge divine armor for Aeneas, including a shield depicting Rome's future glory.
8.modern-da: Overtaler Vulkan til at smede guddommelig rustning til Aeneas, herunder et skjold der afbilder Roms fremtidige storhed.

12.modern-en: Heals Aeneas's wound with a magical herb, enabling him to return to the final duel with Turnus.
12.modern-da: Helbreder Aeneas' sår med en magisk urt, så han kan vende tilbage til den afgørende tvekamp med Turnus.

epithet.en: Queen of the gods, enemy of the Trojans

1.modern-en: Sends a devastating storm to destroy the Trojan fleet, driven by her ancient hatred of Troy.
1.modern-da: Sender en ødelæggende storm for at tilintetgøre den trojanske flåde, drevet af sit ældgamle had til Troja.

4.modern-en: Conspires with Venus to bring Aeneas and Dido together during a hunt, hoping to trap him in Carthage forever.
4.modern-da: Konspirerer med Venus om at bringe Aeneas og Dido sammen under en jagt i håb om at holde ham fanget i Karthago for evigt.

7.modern-en: Unable to stop fate, she unleashes the fury Allecto to incite Turnus and the Latins to war.
7.modern-da: Ude af stand til at standse skæbnen slipper hun furien Allecto løs for at opildne Turnus og latinerne til krig.

12.modern-en: Finally yields to fate and agrees to stop opposing Aeneas — on condition that the Trojans take the Latin name and language.
12.modern-da: Giver endelig efter for skæbnen og indvilger i at stoppe sin modstand mod Aeneas — på betingelse af at trojanerne antager det latinske navn og sprog.

epithet.en: Prophetess of Cumae, guide to the underworld
epithet.da: Profetinde fra Cumae, guide til underverdenen

6.modern-en: Foretells the wars Aeneas will face in Italy. Guides him through the underworld to the Elysian Fields where Anchises waits.
6.modern-da: Forudsiger de krige, Aeneas vil møde i Italien. Guider ham gennem underverdenen til de Elysiske Marker, hvor Anchises venter.

8.modern-en: Sent by his father Evander to fight alongside Aeneas. Young, brave, and eager to prove himself.
8.modern-da: Sendt af sin far Evander for at kæmpe ved Aeneas' side. Ung, modig og ivrig efter at bevise sit værd.

10.modern-en: Fights heroically but is killed by Turnus, who strips his sword-belt as a trophy. His death becomes the emotional core of the war.
10.modern-da: Kæmper heroisk, men dræbes af Turnus, der tager hans sværdbælte som trofæ. Hans død bliver krigens følelsesmæssige kerne.

11.modern-en: His body is sent home to Evander with a solemn procession. Aeneas mourns him as a son.
11.modern-da: Hans lig sendes hjem til Evander med et højtideligt optog. Aeneas sørger over ham som en søn.

epithet.en: Greek king of Pallanteum, Aeneas's ally
epithet.da: Græsk konge af Pallanteum, Aeneas' allierede

8.modern-en: Welcomes Aeneas to his settlement on the future site of Rome. Sends his son Pallas to fight alongside Aeneas.
8.modern-da: Byder Aeneas velkommen i sin bosættelse på det fremtidige Roms grund. Sender sin søn Pallas i kamp ved Aeneas' side.

11.modern-en: Receives his son Pallas's body and mourns his death.
11.modern-da: Modtager sin søn Pallas' lig og sørger over hans død.

7.modern-en: Listed among warriors rallying to Turnus — a maiden dedicated to Diana, swift enough to run across wheat without bending the stalks.
7.modern-da: Nævnt blandt krigerne der slutter sig til Turnus — en jomfru viet til Diana, hurtig nok til at løbe over hvede uden at bøje strå.

11.modern-en: Leads the Volscian cavalry in a brilliant charge. Kills many Trojans before being struck down by a javelin. Her death turns the battle.
11.modern-da: Leder det volskiske kavaleri i et strålende angreb. Dræber mange trojanere, før hun fældes af et spyd. Hendes død vender kampen.

epithet.en: Aeneas's first wife, lost in Troy's fall
epithet.da: Aeneas' første hustru, tabt under Trojas fald

2.modern-en: Lost during the escape from Troy. Her ghost appears to Aeneas, telling him to seek a new kingdom in the west.
2.modern-da: Går tabt under flugten fra Troja. Hendes genfærd viser sig for Aeneas og fortæller ham, at han skal søge et nyt rige i vest.

epithet.en: King of Latium, father of Lavinia

7.modern-en: Welcomes the Trojans and offers Aeneas his daughter Lavinia, fulfilling an oracle. But Juno's interference undoes the peace.
7.modern-da: Byder trojanerne velkommen og tilbyder Aeneas sin datter Lavinia som opfyldelse af et orakel. Men Junos indblanding ødelægger freden.

11.modern-en: Calls a war council and urges peace, but is overruled. A weary king caught between fate and his own people.
11.modern-da: Indkalder krigsråd og opfordrer til fred, men bliver nedstemt. En træt konge fanget mellem skæbnen og sit eget folk.

12.modern-en: Witnesses the final duel. The war ends, and the union of Trojans and Latins begins.
12.modern-da: Overværer den afgørende tvekamp. Krigen ender, og foreningen af trojanere og latinere begynder.

epithet.en: Latin princess, destined bride of Aeneas

7.modern-en: Promised to Aeneas by her father Latinus, fulfilling a prophecy. Her mother and Turnus oppose the match, sparking war.
7.modern-da: Lovet til Aeneas af sin far Latinus som opfyldelse af en profeti. Hendes mor og Turnus modsætter sig forbindelsen, hvilket udløser krig.

12.modern-en: Turnus fights and dies for her. Aeneas's victory secures her as his bride and unites the two peoples.
12.modern-da: Turnus kæmper og dør for hende. Aeneas' sejr sikrer hende som hans brud og forener de to folk.

epithet.en: King of the gods, arbiter of fate

1.modern-en: Reassures Venus that Aeneas's destiny is secure — Rome will be founded.
1.modern-da: Beroliger Venus med, at Aeneas' skæbne er sikker — Rom vil blive grundlagt.

4.modern-en: Sends Mercury to Carthage to remind Aeneas of his destiny and command him to leave Dido.
4.modern-da: Sender Merkur til Karthago for at minde Aeneas om hans skæbne og befale ham at forlade Dido.

10.modern-en: Calls a council of the gods and forbids them from interfering. Fate will decide the outcome.
10.modern-da: Indkalder gudernes råd og forbyder dem at blande sig. Skæbnen vil afgøre udfaldet.

12.modern-en: Brokers the final peace with Juno. The Trojans and Latins will merge into one people.
12.modern-da: Mægler den endelige fred med Juno. Trojanerne og latinerne vil smelte sammen til ét folk.

2.modern-en: A child during Troy's fall, led by the hand through the burning city.
2.modern-da: Et barn under Trojas fald, ledt i hånden gennem den brændende by.

5.modern-en: Leads the Trojan boys in mounted exercises during the funeral games for Anchises.
5.modern-da: Leder de trojanske drenge i rideøvelser under begravelseslegene for Anchises.

9.modern-en: Fights bravely defending the camp while his father is away. Makes his first kill in battle.
9.modern-da: Kæmper tappert i forsvaret af lejren, mens hans far er borte. Dræber sin første fjende i kamp.
